messages:
Carla: Heads up — I'm kicking off a large docs refactor to move /guides -> /tutorials and rename a bunch of anchors. I want to avoid 404s and broken anchors in prod, so plan is staggered small PRs + redirects first. Need reviewers and merge timing suggestions.
Ben: +1. How many PRs are you thinking?
Carla: About 10-12 moves grouped by topic (auth, deployment, examples, SDK). Each move will come with a redirect entry and a linkfix run. Planning to stagger over a day window.
Dmitri: Can we land the redirects first as separate PRs? That buys safety while we do renames.
Carla: Yes — redirects-first is the preferred plan. Redirect PRs as independent, small PRs per top-level dir.
Alice: FYI previews sometimes lose anchor mapping, so please verify anchors in the docs preview before merging.
docs-bot: docs-preview generated: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/branch/refactor-guides-rename (auto note)
Jamie: Any CI failures on the prototype br?
Carla: Prototype had link-check failers on two internal anchors: "authentication:webhooks" and "deployment:profiles". Small fixes but highlights the risk.
Ben: Suggest adding placeholder redirect files for each renamed doc so old URLs resolve immediately.
Carla: Good call. I'll include placeholder redirects and a short migration note on moved pages.
Kevin: Reminder — avoid merging during 15:00-18:00 PT peak deploy window. Also loop in SRE for canary monitoring.
Carla: Proposed merge schedule: 1) merge redirects first (one PR per top-level dir) -> verify preview -> 2) merge move PRs in small batches (3–4 files each) staggered every 20–30 minutes between 09:30–11:30 PT tomorrow. After each batch run link-check and smoke tests.
Dmitri: Assign me to review redirects. I'll watch for query param, trailing slash, and fragment handling.
Carla: Assigned you. Also assigning Alice + Ben for move PR reviews. PR links to follow.
Alice: Local validation command if you want a head start:
```
npm run docs:build && node ./scripts/link-checker.js --base-url=https://preview.docs.redwood.ai
```
Ben: Also add a note in docs/agents.md about the new structure so our crawlers/bots don't miss old anchors.
Carla: Will add that. Also creating a migration guide at /docs/migration-guides/refactor-guides-2026.md describing redirects, how to update external links, and SDK snippet changes.
Jamie: Who's doing the merges? I can take the move PRs once redirects are merged and SRE gives the go-ahead.
Carla: Thanks — plan is: I'll merge redirects after CI passes, tag SRE, then @Jamie to merge move batches. Tagging @Oncall for monitoring.
Oncall: Noted. Please post a short deploy note in #eng-sre before each merge batch. We'll monitor error rates and 2-min latency.
Ben: One more: some SDK snippets reference old anchor names. Create a sweep ticket to update code samples across SDK docs.
Carla: Added ticket DOCS-1527 and will reference it in each PR description.
Dmitri: Proposal: add a temporary banner at the top of redirected pages pointing to the new location for 30 days, plus noindex on the old path.
Carla: Agree — short redirect banner + noindex is sensible.
Alice: :thumbsup:
Carla: Ok moving forward — PRs opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4021 (redirects), https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4022 (move chunk A), https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4023 (move chunk B). CI running now.
Ben: I'll review 4021 now.
Carla: Thanks — I'll update this thread once CI is green and SRE confirms monitoring.
